title: See every end-to-end test in one catalog
statement: As a developer, I can open one catalog of the end-to-end tests that prove the app works, so I know what we can rely on without reading the test suite.
overview: Today Quality appears only inside each feature; the Overview has no QA entry. A catalog entry is an existing test case, not a new record, so this is a new view of what Quality holds.

acceptance_criteria.statement: The Overview has a QA entry that opens the catalog, and it lists test cases from every feature on one page.
Each entry shows its title, the feature that holds it, the criteria it verifies, and a link to its code.
`query e2e-catalog` returns the same entries through the standard snapshot and pagination envelope.
A Saga with no end-to-end tests shows how to start one, and reports no health failure.
